Treasury Announces Marketable Borrowing Estimates

August 3, 2026

Sources and Uses Table

WASHINGTON -- The U.S. Department of the Treasury today announced its current estimates.

  • During the July–September 2026 quarter, Treasury expects to borrow $739 billion in privately-held net marketable debt, assuming an end-of-September cash balance of $950 billion. The borrowing estimate changed.
  • During the October–December 2026 quarter, Treasury expects to borrow $628 billion in privately-held net marketable debt, assuming an end-of-December cash balance of $850 billion.
  • During the April–June 2026 quarter, Treasury borrowed $190 billion and ended the quarter with a cash balance of $919 billion.
